name: fm1-opl3-tracker
description: FMY262: an OPL3 (YMF262) tracker for the M-VAVE FM-1 (custom firmware, workbench and browser prototype)

scripts.test: cd tests && mkdir -p out && node t24.cjs && node t27.cjs && node t34.cjs && node t35.cjs && node t36.cjs && node t37.cjs && node t30.cjs && node t42.cjs && node t43.cjs && node t44.cjs && node t45.cjs && node t46.cjs && node t47.cjs && node t48.cjs
scripts.workbench: npm run build && cd vendor/fm1-base && PATH=$HOME/.docker/bin:$PATH .venv/bin/python tools/build.py ../../firmware/tracker >/dev/null && .venv/bin/python tools/build.py --web ../../firmware/tracker >/dev/null && cd ../.. && python3 firmware/tracker/tools/make_workbench.py
